examples.title: Hidden compositions
examples.what: Combinations of trained operations that training never produces, such as a product followed by a step.

examples.title: Chains with an unseen first step
examples.what: A start and a first step never paired in training.

examples.title: The target
examples.what: The expression the project aims at, and random 4-6 operation expressions over every concept.

examples.title: Middle band: arx ladder
examples.what: Add-rotate-xor rounds with random round keys each episode: x = rotl(x ^ k, 7) + y; y = rotl(y, 3) ^ x.

examples.title: Middle band: random
examples.what: A fresh random expression of 6-10 operations each episode, longer than anything trained.

examples.title: Middle band: sbox
examples.what: A random 4-bit substitution table applied to every nibble of a ^ b, then added to a.

examples.title: Middle band: data-dependent
examples.what: Steps chosen by the data: Collatz-like loops and branches on a bit of a.

examples.title: Middle band: automaton
examples.what: Cellular automaton rules 30 and 110 run for 2 or 4 steps on the bits of a, then xor b.

examples.title: Middle band: mixes
examples.what: Rotations (never a training operation), xor and multiplication by odd constants.

examples.title: Middle band: deep
examples.what: Expressions of 4-8 operations with fixed constants.

examples.title: Middle band: floor: products
examples.what: Squares and products of derived values (scored, but not the headline).

examples.title: Middle band: loops
examples.what: Loops it never trained on.

examples.title: Middle band: computed products
examples.what: Products of values computed from a and b: its known weak spot.

examples.title: Middle band: control: hash
examples.what: Hash functions and many mixing rounds: nothing should beat chance here.
